items.title: Nvidia interim-CEO Colette Kress speaks on quarterly revenue hitting $116B
items.summary: Nvidia (NVDA) interim CEO Colette Kress spoke about the company's third quarter earnings report, which recorded revenue of $116 billion, more than doubling year over year, and raised its fiscal 2028 revenue growth outlook.

items.title: Nvidia chair says board 'does not intend to reinstate Jensen as CEO'
items.summary: Nvidia (NVDA) board Chairman Harvey Jones said on the company's third quarter earnings call that it does not intend to reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO, a week after he resigned from the post following "personal behavior inconsistent with the company's code of conduct."

items.title: AMD, Broadcom, CoreWeave stocks rise on Nvidia earnings beat
items.summary: Semiconductor and AI infrastructure stocks moved higher in after-hours trading on Tuesday after AI chip heavyweight Nvidia posted better-than-expected quarterly results.

items.title: Nvidia earnings: Why Jensen turmoil won't have a near-term impact on the numbers
items.summary: Uniphore CEO Umesh Sachdev and Morningstar equity strategist Brian Colello sit down with Deirdre Bosa to share their thoughts on Nvidia's (NVDA) latest earnings results in the wake of Jensen Huang's departure from the company.

items.title: Nvidia’s Q3 earnings show its advantage as the bank of the AI boom
items.summary: Yahoo Finance's Deirdre Bosa explains that Nvidia's (NVDA) role as a quasi-lender to smaller neo cloud customers means that part of its sales depends on customers it helps finance, which shows up in receivables and free cash flow.

items.title: Why a Jensen Huang comeback could become a major battle in Washington
items.summary: Semafor's editor in chief, Ben Smith, sits down with Deirdre Bosa to explain why Jensen Huang's return to Nvidia (NVDA) would be so contentious among politicians in Washington.

items.title: What to make of Jensen Huang's apology letter
items.summary: Deirdre Bosa outlines what former Jensen Huang had to say in his apology letter posted on X, just hours before Nvidia's (NVDA) third quarter earnings results.

items.title: Nvidia beats Q3 earnings expectations in first report without Jensen Huang
items.summary:
AI chipmaker Nvidia (NVDA) beats on Q3 revenue and earnings, its first report since founder and CEO Jensen Huang stepped down after reports of extramarital affairs.

Revenue came in at $115.8 billion vs. $109.1 billion expected. Nvidia also showed net profit of $65.3 billion and forecast Q4 revenue above Wall Street estimates.
